findings.title: The frame's collaboration_revision is the current revision at relay time, not the event's own revision; a handoff frame can carry the post-status revision
findings.resolution: Match frames only by exact event_seq and the ':issue' event_id; record and compare revision without using it as the match key

findings.title: The status write receipt has no event_seq, so the expected event identity was unspecified
findings.resolution: Require quiescence before each timed write, read S from the writer's authoritative GET and expect S+1; one status change emits exactly one event

findings.title: Writes issued right after the previous delivery are phase-locked to the 500 ms relay ticker
findings.resolution: Seeded uniform [0,500) ms pre-write jitter, recorded per round and in the manifest

findings.title: A pooled p95 alone lets five observers be late on every event
findings.resolution: Gate on zero missing samples, pooled p95 <= 2000 ms and p95 of each event's slowest observer <= 2000 ms; report per-observer p95

findings.title: Percentile method and missing-sample handling were not a testable definition
findings.resolution: Nearest rank with integer rank = ceil(N*95/100); non-converged, failed and NOT_RUN samples sort as +Infinity; counterexample tests first

findings.title: Pool size above the product default, run selection or relabelled warm-ups could improve the number
findings.resolution: Product default pool with the effective value recorded; every complete run gets a new id and is retained; warm-up count is pre-registered

findings.title: Observer disconnect handling was undefined; the hub does not replay frames
findings.resolution: Reconnect only at round boundaries; samples during the outage are missing; a post-reconnect read is recorded separately

findings.title: Only the creator or current handler can change status, so per-user writes need handoffs whose events interleave with status events
findings.resolution: Quiescence barrier waits for the previous event to reach all observers before the timed write; handoff timing is recorded outside the denominator

findings.title: Host, closure and memory Providers print the same fixture kind; the closure Provider writes its comment before the callback
findings.resolution: Bind the host Provider source and binary hashes in the manifest and require a 404 pre-check on the result id in the warm-up run

findings.title: 20 runs x 5 writes left finalization with 20 samples and clustered business writes
findings.resolution: 100 independent runs, one business result and one finalization each; both distributions must meet p95 <= 5000 ms

findings.title: Measuring write-back on a small issue understates the 100-collaborator scenario
findings.resolution: Run the write-back phase on the issue with the same 100 participants while the 100 observer sockets stay connected

findings.title: sendHostComment, seedHostRuntime and hostEnvironment need a browser page or Web/renderer keys
findings.resolution: Use the existing API-only control and mention-comment pattern with the harness's own environment guard

findings.title: act() waits with expect.poll, and the test poller interval is 50 ms
findings.resolution: End point is the parallel authoritative read; queue and launch time is reported separately and excluded from the 5 s gate

findings.title: The fixture falls back to the default local database and a new spec would be picked up by whole-directory runs
findings.resolution: Explicit opt-in key, loopback and non-default database guard, /api/config check; otherwise skip

findings.title: Line numbers for collaboration-host-runtime.ts in the research predate the S3 edit of that file
findings.resolution: design.md names symbols; the research file was left unchanged and its errata are listed in plan-review.md

verified_facts: Registration is limited to 30 per IP per 5 minutes and requires signup to be enabled; login to 300 per IP per minute and 10 per account per 5 minutes (server/internal/handler/auth_password.go:132,135,176,191)
Register and login routes carry no additional auth rate limiter (server/cmd/server/router.go:1482-1483)
Recipient eligibility needs an enabled account with a password credential and no forced change; onboarding is not required (server/pkg/db/queries/collaboration_recipients.sql:13-15)
Collaboration participant invites do not use the workspace invitation limiters and no participant cap was found

Account WebSocket: first-frame auth within 10 s, auth_ack, issue subscribe_ack, send buffer 256 with slow-client eviction, per-frame re-authorization (server/internal/realtime/hub.go:802,955,983,1107,1173,1200; realtime/collaboration.go:68)
Node 22.23.2 native WebSocket sends no Origin header (observed on a throwaway loopback socket), which checkOrigin accepts (hub.go:161)

The relay scans every 500 ms, publishes an empty account hint per participant and then collaboration:changed with an injected event_id (service/collaboration_realtime.go:65-68,134,155; realtime/collaboration.go:177)
A runtime comment's id equals its request id, so GET comments/{commentId} is a valid exact read (service/collaboration_squad.go:252; router.go:1738)
The host Provider performs scripted comment writes through the run-local CLI and prints a final result after release (e2e/fixtures/collaboration-host-provider.go:57-62,364-394)
All five paths in the original jsonl files exist; all paths in the rewritten files exist
